thread:
Tess (Design): dropping a different take on the p95 + heatmap card. idea: move sampling controls into the p95 tooltip so the compact header stays clean. figma: https://www.figma.com/file/xyz/tooltip-sampler-experiment

Tess (Design): main tradeoff: tooltip keeps UI minimal but hides controls behind hover/focus. is that acceptable for power users who change sampling during incidents?

Ravi (Eng): hiding behind tooltip is risky for keyboard users unless tooltip is focusable and traps focus while open. also increases JS surface for tooltip lifecycle. prefer a visible microbadge that opens a popover.

Aly (PM): ops want fast access. tooltip ok if tooltip can be opened by click/tap and has persistent focusable controls. otherwise prefer inline badge. we could use tooltip by default and expose a feature-flag to pin the control for heavy users.

Noor (A11y): accessibility constraints: if tooltip contains interactive controls, it must be a true dialog or popover with aria-modal=false, focus management (focus moves into it), and close on Escape. Also provide keyboard affordance: tooltip triggered by Enter/Space on the p95 label. aria-describedby should link p95 value -> tooltip content for screen readers.

Tess (Design): got it. I'll design the tooltip as a popover with header "Adaptive sampling" and presets (1/1, 1/5, 1/10) + slider. the p95 label becomes focusable and shows a chevron when interactive. visual: https://img.redwood.com/proto/tooltip-sampler.png

Ravi (Eng): implementation notes: popover approach ok. ensure it's non-blocking (role=dialog, aria-modal=false). we'll reuse existing popover component and add a11y helpers. prefer popover that anchors to the p95 datapoint not the card edge.

Aly (PM): analytics: track `sampling_interaction` with method: tooltip|badge|toolbar and preset selected. also track `copy_visible_clicked` when users copy CSV. keep props low-cardinality.

Noor (A11y): microcopy: avoid "Auto"—use "Adaptive sampling" in visible labels and aria attributes. toast on copy should be aria-live polite and include number of rows copied ("Copied 42 rows"). ensure focus returns to the triggering element after popover close.

Tess (Design): one more visual a11y ask: heatmap legend buckets need pattern overlays (dots/stripes) in addition to color, and hover states should increase contrast. will include patterns in the mock.

Ravi (Eng): we'll add pattern support in the canvas renderer. note: pattern tiling may hurt performance at very small cell sizes; suggest using pattern only in legend and high-level hover states, not every cell.

Noor (A11y): pattern-in-legend is fine but we should provide a text alternative for the legend (sr-only list: "Low latency, Medium, High"). tooltips should include full readable labels like "p95: 320 ms (high)".

Tess (Design): action items: update figma with popover states (open/closed/focus), tooltip microcopy strings, and legend patterns. add a short a11y checklist: focus management, aria-pressed for presets, aria-live toast, sr-only legend.

Aly (PM): rollout plan: feature flag tooltip-by-default, offer pin-to-toolbar setting per-user. enable telemetry to compare discovery rates.

Ravi (Eng): estimate: popover + telemetry + throttle on copy (5s) -> 1 sprint if design assets are ready. will make sampling preset change gated by flag.

ui-bot: uploaded 3 assets to staging/latency/tooltip-sampler/ (build 2026-03-26T11:40Z)

Noor (A11y): happy to review copy and focus behavior once pushed. want to pair on keyboard flows.

Tess (Design): thanks everyone 1: will update and ping. end.
